description: (needs account token) Returns when each domain of a site renews, the price, and whether auto-renew is on. autorenew false with confirm=true stops the renewal. autorenew true is refused, because it commits a charge. Does not pay.

autorenew.description: false stops the yearly renewal when confirm is true. true is refused, because it commits a charge. Absent means only read.

confirm.description: True applies the change. False leaves it unchanged and the reply describes what would change.

domain.description: Optional: which domain, when changing auto-renew. Default: the site's main domain.

site.description: The address of a site on this account, for example myproject.dropthehassle.app.

name: domain_renewal
title: Domain renewal
